semiconductor_relevance: High — Kato Light Metal Industry specializes in bonding technologies for oxide-coated materials, which are critical for semiconductor packaging and assembly.
summary: Kato Light Metal Industry develops advanced bonding technologies that enable the joining of various oxide-coated materials, including metals, ceramics, and glass. Their solutions focus on creating ultra-thin, low thermal resistance joints that are essential for high-performance semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Sub-micron heterogeneous joints with high thermal conductivity
